_label: Assumed rates for cost ESTIMATES only; not tax advice. Every figure computed from this file is labelled 'estimated' with these assumptions.

gst.note: Assumed 18% for electronic modules and components (e.g. HSN 8542 integrated circuits, listed at 18% after the 22 Sep 2025 GST rate changes by a secondary source). Not checked against the CBIC rate notification. Some categories may differ; add them to by_family (keyed by specs.family) when sourced.

import.heading: 9804 (personal imports, courier)
import.quote: Basic Customs Duty (BCD) 10% of X ... Social Welfare Surcharge (SWS) 10% of (BCD) ... IGST 28% of (X + BCD+SWS) ... Total Duty (1+2+3) 42.08% of X
import.note: Chennai Customs FAQ on courier personal imports (uploaded Oct 2025). The 22 Sep 2025 GST changes removed the 28% slab for most domestic goods; whether IGST on heading 9804 changed is not confirmed against a CBIC notification. No duty-free threshold is applied (the FAQ gives none for courier imports). Custodian handling and courier clearance charges are not included.

fx.note: RBI reference rate (95.9927) as published by MSEI. Customs assesses with the CBIC-notified exchange rate, which can differ; card payments add bank markup.

courier.note: Placeholder flat express-courier charge for one small parcel from a US or global distributor. Not sourced; calibrate with 2-3 real quotes (docs/03-delivery/06-cost-and-budget.md section 5). Many distributors waive or change shipping above order values.
